# LDtk sample projects (test fixtures)

These `.ldtk` files are the sample projects shipped with LDtk 1.5.3 (MIT, Sébastien Benard,
https://ldtk.io). They are used only as parity fixtures: Worlds imports them and must bake the
same `autoLayerTiles` LDtk saved.

Atlas images, as credited in LDtk's samples README:

- `Cavernas_by_Adam_Saltsman.png`: "Cavernas", free texture pack by Adam Saltsman (https://adamatomic.itch.io/cavernas)
- `Inca_back2_by_Kronbits.png`, `Inca_front_by_Kronbits-extended.png`: "Inca" by Kronbits (https://kronbits.itch.io/inca-game-assets)

Not for use in the game.
